title: Pavlova
description: Pavlova is a dish from Australia featuring pasteurized egg whites, white vinegar, cornstarch, whipping cream. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Whisk pasteurized egg whites to soft peaks, gradually add sugar and whip to a firm glossy meringue; fold in vinegar and cornstarch.
Shape a high meringue round with a shallow central well on parchment; no yeast proofing is needed.
Bake the shaped pavlova at a low 110–120°C until crisp outside and soft in the center; cool in the switched-off oven to prevent cracking.
Cool the finished meringue completely in the switched-off oven with the door ajar before adding cream; do not refrigerate the bare shell.
Whisk or whip the listed ingredients to a smooth, light consistency, then keep cool until needed.
Arrange the fully cooked and prepared parts of the dish on plates or in the intended serving vessel, adding the listed toppings or accompaniments just before serving.
